note:
USACE island campground on Mississippi River backwaters.  Many sites are right on the water.  --AWH
The north tip of the Potters North loop (around 060) opens across lawn onto the main river; its east row (034-038) faces a wide backwater slough. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, catalog, calendar and site photos read; imagery + 3DEP. 126 sites (121 electric at 50 A, 101 with water; 5 tent), to 99 ft, 2 pull-through; $26 for 2027 (unchanged); season 05-01..10-23. Riverfront (--AWH) confirmed: no levee, 060 ~25 m from the main pool over lawn, 034-038 ~20-30 m from a ~90 m slough. Pin moves ~600 m from a picnic shelter to the sites. Phone 815-259-3628 (none stored).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront (--AWH note, kept) confirmed. The campground is on an island in Pool 13 with no levee (3DEP pads 5-7 ft above the water). 060 (41.952469,-90.120208), a reservable nightly electric+water site, sits ~25 m from the open main-river pool across lawn and a sandy shore path (2022 rec.gov photo shows its table near the shore). 034-038 (e.g. 038 at 41.950572,-90.117162) sit ~20-30 m across open lawn from a duckweed-covered backwater slough about 90 m wide. The RIVE loop (079-098, 750 m north) looks across a 60-150 m marsh fringe to open river (088 photo): riverview. HPOI 114/118/123/124 are under canopy beside a floating-vegetation marsh.

PIN: stored 41.9517,-90.1108 is the 'Stone' picnic shelter on the Thomson side of the causeway (rec.gov 41.951661,-90.111267), ~600 m east of the sites. Move to 41.9512,-90.1181 (site centroid; the main loops' centre is about 41.9505,-90.1180).

FIT (data quirk, not a drop): 9 electric sites (PMAN 040; RIVE 081, 083-089) list trailer, fifth wheel, pickup camper and camper van but not RV/Motorhome in rec.gov's permitted equipment; the other 112 list RV. Site 105 posts a 20-ft, 051 a 25-ft limit; every other electric site is 28 ft or more.
SITES: catalog 126 overnight (121 electric) vs description 125 (120 electric). Water at 101 sites; the notice says 33, 79-97 and 127-131 have none.
